The document describes engineering specifications for two rotary triple offset on-off valves used in an HTF heater system.
Valves XV 205-30 and XV 205-31 are for inlet and outlet respectively, both with a flow rate of 771000 lbm/h at 650 psia pressure and 750 ºF temperature.
The valves have a design pressure of 600 psig and are classified as Class 600.
They use Tyco Biffi Algas actuators with a stroke time of 40sec / 30sec and HART communication protocol.
Valves must comply with hazardous area classification (Class 1, Division 2, Group D) and undergo hydraulic and leakage tests.
